primary.title: Explained | How Nvidia's solid earnings sparked a rally in Taiwan Index and AI stocks
primary.summary: Nvidia's impressive quarterly performance has sparked an AI rally, boosting Taiwan’s TAIEX index by 0.8%. TSMC, benefiting from Nvidia's demand, saw positive growth projections.
